## Navigating the Web Application

The accompanying web application allows users to explore athlete performance data and predicted aging curves interactively. The interface is organized into multiple tabs, each serving a distinct purpose:

## Athlete Comparisons

-   **Choose Event**: Select a track or field event from the dropdown menu.
-   **Choose Athletes**: Pick one or more athletes to compare.
-   **Visualization**: An interactive Trelliscope display shows the selected athletes’ observed performance data. You can:
    -   Scroll through athlete panels.
    -   Zoom in/out and pan for closer inspection.
    -   Filter or search athletes by name.

## Athlete Aging Curves Prediction

-   **Choose Athlete**: Select a specific athlete from the dropdown list.
-   **Choose Event**: Pick the event for which you want to see predicted aging curves.
-   **Output**: The app displays:
    -   Observed data points (in blue).
    -   Predicted aging curve (smooth line).
    -   World class standard (horizontal line).

## Navigation Tips

-   Use the **tab menu** at the top to switch between sections.
-   Dropdown menus have a search feature: start typing to quickly find the desired athlete or event.
-   Plots can be downloaded by right-clicking and selecting “Save image as…”.
-   For large datasets, loading may take a few seconds. The progress indicator will appear until the plot is ready.

This appendix ensures that first-time users can navigate the app efficiently and make full use of its interactive features.
